title: INC Foundation and Bengal Political Response
subtitle: The Indian National Congress held its first session in Bombay from 28 to 31 December 1885
summary: The Indian National Congress held its first session in Bombay from 28 to 31 December 1885. Bengal already had associational politics, including the Indian Association founded in Calcutta in 1876. The available event sources do not support a detailed account of Bengal-specific reactions in 1885.
heroTagline: The Indian National Congress held its first session in Bombay from 28 to 31 December 1885
whyItMatters: Congress created an all-India forum for political discussion, while Bengal’s earlier associations show regional political organization preceded it. Bengal’s diverse groups should not be assigned a single response.
